thread:
noah_cs: Starting a dedicated onramp for Krypton Systems. Need quota plan, autoscale knobs, and a runbook for their replay. High priority renewal next month, so clear exec signal needed. @priya_infra @ash_sre
priya_infra: We can reserve 5xA100 in us-west-2 for 04/20-04/25. Recommend lanes: baseline (min=2) + burst (max=9). Need signed SOC and KMS ARN to enable their key.
ash_sre: Proposed autoscale metric = queued_token_rate_per_gpu. Suggest min_instances=2, max_instances=9, cooldown=60s. Fallback: quantized-4bit model when queue >300 for >45s. Also enable prefix prefill during shadow.
qa_k: Load plan: shadow 1h at 10% -> stepped 20/50/100% (10m holds) -> 4h soak at full. I'll run two replays: prod-trace replay + synthetic Locust. Quick Locust sample below:
```
from locust import HttpUser, task
class U(HttpUser):
    @task
    def gen(self):
        self.client.post('/v1/generate', json={"input":"<sample>"})
```
Will upload CSVs and metrics to S3.
devrel: Krypton will provide sanitized traces and top 150 prefixes. We'll ask them to scrub any PII and mark tool-calls.
noah_cs: I asked Krypton for traces; they said ETA 6 hours. Also scheduled enablement demo 04/21 16:00 PT — include product + solutions.
account_exec: Renewal note: exec asked for a 1-paragraph post-soak summary and cost delta. This will influence Q2 buy decision.
priya_infra: Temporary quota bump request? For the full soak we can approve 1.2M tokens/day for 24 hours. Need ops to add rule and auto-remove.
ops-bot: Quota rule created: qrule-3619876543, expires 2024-04-21T08:00:00Z. Pool reservation: ded-usw2-krypton-3619876543 confirmed.
qa_k: Smoke (30m @50 rps) scheduled tomorrow 04/20 07:00 PT. After smoke I'll post GPU util, p95, kv-cache hit%, and any OOMs.
ash_sre: For rollout policy: canary 1% -> 5% after 10m if p95 < 350ms and errors <0.4%. Increment by 10% every 15m. Rollback if error rate >0.8% or p95 > 500ms.
devrel: Also enabling X-Krypton-ReqId passthrough header to let their engineers map traces. We'll rate-limit logging of the header.
qa_k: After smoke: GPU util 41%, p95 230ms, kv-cache hit 11%. No OOMs. Logs: s3://redwood-loadtests/krypton/3619876543/smoke.log
priya_infra: I've pushed autoscale policy to infra: min=2 max=9 metric=queued_token_rate_per_gpu. Canary rollout configured (10m canary).
noah_cs: Thanks. I'll draft the exec-ready summary template and attach billing estimate for the soak. Please keep artifacts linked for the account. :thumbsup:
account_exec: Marking renewal_risk=low if soak is clean + exec brief produced.
ops-bot: Reminder: runbook template: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-onramp. Calendar event created: Krypton onramp - full soak (04/21).
